manifest.title: Slop Chaos v1
manifest.subtitle: Fireworks frontier panel · 10 cursed constraint traps · OpenRouter fallback (no Fireworks key)
manifest.description: No filters. No dignity. Haunted toasters, racoon accountants, goose HR, mayonnaise JSON, and the classic F-count trap — every task is a machine-checkable rule contract designed to make 'smart' models look drunk. Built to pressure-test Kimi K3 (the frontend darling) against other Fireworks serverless heavyweights under zero_context. Same harness, same rules, no LLM judges.

tasks.label: haunted toaster recall, 17 words, banned glue words

goose HR ALL CAPS unpaid lunch
tomato soup to alien, heavy taboo
